original_obligation.target_paraphrase: Bridge the exact boosted tensor to the algebraic h0 I + h2 coefficient matrix required by the second first-order inverse expression in OPTICAL_THEOREMS equation (27), and prove an explicit O(|beta|^2) perturbation bound in the existing Euclidean operator norm.
explicit_assumptions: D is a fixed real symmetric 3x3 matrix where symmetry is stated.
Norm bounds use q beta < 1 or 0 <= eNorm beta <= r < 1.
The sourceward null direction is K=(-1,n), q n=1.
No positivity, invertibility, nonzero trace, or small-shear premise is added.

scope.conclusion: Exact algebraic coefficient identities, ideal-sky quadratic expansion, exact coefficient-matrix perturbation, and explicit Euclidean operator-norm pointwise/ball bounds.
not_claimed: the second inverse formula of equation (27)

theorem_signature:
theorem coefficientMatrix_eq (D : M3) (beta : V3) : coefficientMatrix D beta = timeCoefficient D beta • (1 : M3) + spatialBlock D beta

theorem quadrupoleCoefficient_trace (D : M3) (beta : V3) : (quadrupoleCoefficient D beta).trace = 0

theorem quadrupoleCoefficient_symmetric (D : M3) (hD : ∀ i j, D i j = D j i) (beta : V3) : ∀ i j, quadrupoleCoefficient D beta i j = quadrupoleCoefficient D beta j i

theorem algebraic_sky_expansion (D : M3) (hD : ∀ i j, D i j = D j i) (beta n : V3) (hn : q n = 1) : dotProduct (observerNull n) ((boostedB D beta).mulVec (observerNull n)) = monopoleCoefficient D beta + dot3 (dipoleMap D beta) n + dot3 n ((quadrupoleCoefficient D beta).mulVec n)

theorem coefficientMatrix_zero (D : M3) : coefficientMatrix D 0 = D

theorem coefficientMatrix_perturbation_exact (D : M3) (hD : ∀ i j, D i j = D j i) (beta : V3) : coefficientMatrix D beta - D = (gamma beta ^ 2 * sourceQuadratic D beta) • (1 : M3) + boostA beta • (outer beta (D.mulVec beta) + outer (D.mulVec beta) beta) + (boostA beta ^ 2 * sourceQuadratic D beta) • outer beta beta

theorem coefficientMatrix_perturbation_norm_pointwise (D : M3) (hD : ∀ i j, D i j = D j i) (beta : V3) (hbeta : q beta < 1) : opNorm (coefficientMatrix D beta - D) ≤ (2 * opNorm D / (1 - q beta)) * eNorm beta ^ 2

theorem coefficientMatrix_perturbation_norm_ball (D : M3) (hD : ∀ i j, D i j = D j i) (beta : V3) (r : ℝ) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1) (hbeta : eNorm beta ≤ r) : opNorm (coefficientMatrix D beta - D) ≤ (2 * opNorm D / (1 - r ^ 2)) * eNorm beta ^ 2
accepted_lemma_signatures: timeCoefficient D beta = gamma beta ^ 2 * sourceQuadratic D beta
(outer v w).mulVec x = (dot3 w x) • v
spatialBlock D beta *v beta = -(1/2) • dipoleMap D beta
coefficientMatrix D beta *v beta = -(1/2) • dipoleMap D beta + timeCoefficient D beta • beta
